readings: For each patient, use lab rows with non-null HGB and non-null, nonzero HCT. Compute HGB/HCT for each such row, then average those test ratios to get the patient's ratio. Compute the overall average of these patient ratios. Keep patients whose ratio exceeds it, and calculate each patient's excess. Compute the average ratio among those retained patients, then keep only patients whose ratio exceeds that group average and calculate each patient's excess over it. Return one row containing the unrounded averages, across the final patients, of their ratios and their two excess amounts.

For each patient, use lab rows with non-null HGB and non-null, nonzero HCT. Divide that patient's average HGB by their average HCT across those rows to get the patient's ratio. Compute the overall average of these patient ratios. Keep patients whose ratio exceeds it, and calculate each patient's excess. Compute the average ratio among those retained patients, then keep only patients whose ratio exceeds that group average and calculate each patient's excess over it. Return one row containing the unrounded averages, across the final patients, of their ratios and their two excess amounts.
queries:
WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT <> 0
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
retained AS (
    SELECT p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS first_excess
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM retained
)
SELECT AVG(r.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(r.first_excess) AS avg_first_excess,
       AVG(r.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS avg_second_excess
FROM retained AS r
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE r.ratio > g.avg_ratio

WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT <> 0
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
retained AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS first_excess
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
),
retained_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM retained
)
SELECT
    AVG(r.ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(r.first_excess) AS average_first_excess,
    AVG(r.ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS average_second_excess
FROM retained AS r
CROSS JOIN retained_average AS a
WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio
